audit.note: expandToLevel and collapseAll are round-trip-free control_by_id actions; the port raises no backend event at all

deviations.what: handleSelectChange does this.byId('Tree').expandToLevel(oEvent.getParameter('selectedItem').getKey()) and onCollapseAllPress does oTree.collapseAll(). Both methods ARE whitelisted in CONTROL_METHODS, so both are round-trip-free follow_up_action( control_by_id, ... ) wires (app 248/365 idiom): the Select's change carries ${$parameters>/selectedItem}.getKey() straight into expandToLevel, and the button calls collapseAll with no argument at all.

onInit does the same expandToLevel(1) a second time, before any interaction, so the tree comes up with its first level open - which is what the toolbar's own 'Initially expand to Level1' text and the Select's selectedKey='1' announce. It is issued once per render as a frontend action.

Tree.json is the 44-node variant this sample and TreeExpandMulti ship (six Node1-n branches, five levels deep). It is seeded verbatim into five nested ABAP structure levels - the depth of the data is the depth of the type (app 437 precedent).
